safetyPreconditions: Freeze catalog/source and rebuild generated pages before a coherent QA run.
Use the owned loopback preview with a disposable synthetic product DB; page startup can request a short-lived form token through GET.
No existing browser profile, signed-in session, production DB or remote service is used.
Coordinate browser/GPU runs with brand-video capture and performance measurements.
No form or mail is submitted; only a local brief TXT download is exercised. External resources and non-GET/HEAD browser requests are blocked and reported.

browserMatrix.allProjectCases: Every case URL from current V2 catalog JSON in both browsers at each of360,390,768,1440px. At19 identities this is152 case visits, with exact IDs, platforms, date/revision/environment/source provenance, source anchors and decoded gallery images.

browserMatrix.mobileMeaning: Viewport/touch emulation, not a physical-device test. Firefox does not receive unsupported isMobile option.

overrides.PK_QA_BROWSERS: chrome,firefox or one engine for a coordinated split run
overrides.PK_QA_SCREENSHOTS: Set 0 to suppress screenshots; visual approval remains OPEN.
overrides.PK_QA_FIREFOX: Optional explicit compatible Firefox engine path
overrides.PK_QA_EXPECTED_COUNT: Optional release-specific guard; command explicitly expects19 while all ID/case loops and totals derive from JSON.
overrides.PK_QA_EXTRA: Set0 after first width per engine to avoid repeating forcedWebGL/noJS/ChromeCPU stress contexts; all responsive main checks and all cases still run.

releaseGates.automatedChecks: No current result until executed; browser launch/environment failures are BLOCKED, not PASS.
releaseGates.sourceIntegrity: Before/after hashes detect edits during QA and block a coherent final verdict.
releaseGates.visualReview: Required even if geometry checks pass. Canvas text/refraction/overlap need actual image inspection.
releaseGates.operatorLegalFacts: SOURCE_PRESENT_LOCAL name/address/contact; publication reviewOPEN. Retention/processors/logging/legal applicability remain owner/legal facts.
releaseGates.mailboxDelivery: NOT VERIFIED; mailto syntax is not a delivery test.
releaseGates.externalLinksAndPublicDeployment: NOT VERIFIED by local helper; external URLs inventoried without network calls.

preview.scope: Owned isolated local preview; disposable synthetic product DB

browserExecution: Split each engine/width into an independent browser process after outer-process interruptions; no parallel GPU sessions.
